CREATE TABLE public.ddos_scrubbing_flows (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  supersedes_id uuid NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key text NOT NULL,
  received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  sample_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  client_ip inet NOT NULL,
  item_code text NOT NULL,
  metric_value integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT ddos_scrubbing_flows_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_ddos_scrubbing_flows_supersedes_id FOREIGN KEY (supersedes_id) REFERENCES public.ddos_scrubbing_flows (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT chk_ddos_scrubbing_flows_metric_value CHECK (metric_value >= 0)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_ddos_scrubbing_flows_supersedes_id ON public.ddos_scrubbing_flows (supersedes_id);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ddos_scrubbing_flows_reject_mutation()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Append-only table cannot be updated' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_ddos_scrubbing_flows_reject_mutation
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.ddos_scrubbing_flows
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_ddos_scrubbing_flows_reject_mutation();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ddos_scrubbing_flows_force_received_at()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$

  NEW.received_at := COALESCE(NEW.received_at, now());
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_ddos_scrubbing_flows_force_received_at
BEFORE INSERT ON public.ddos_scrubbing_flows
